stages.name: A
stages.prompt: Add four helpers to textutil, each with table-driven tests: Slugify (lowercase, runs of spaces and punctuation become one hyphen, no leading or trailing hyphens), Truncate(s string, n int) (keep n runes, append an ellipsis when it cut), Title (capitalize each word), and Wrap(s string, width int) []string (wrap on word boundaries). This is a longer job and I may have to stop you and pick it up later, so keep track of where you are.

checks.name: all four exist
checks.run: grep -q 'func Slugify' textutil.go && grep -q 'func Truncate' textutil.go && grep -q 'func Title' textutil.go && grep -q 'func Wrap' textutil.go
